status: families NOT yet recorded: record them (owner decision) BEFORE any labelling begins; hosted teacher runs and MODEL_ASSISTED_REVIEW labels are refused by tools/dialogue-reader-labels.js and tools/dialogue-reader-replay.js until then

recommendation.teacher: a non-Claude top-tier reasoning model (Claude authored much of the current prompt, fixtures and review material)

rules: The teacher's model family differs from the automated review-labeler's family.
Teacher output never produces gold, in any label state.
An evaluated reader arm is never the label source of its own evaluation (gold whose labeller shares the arm's family is excluded from that arm's score).

Automated label suggestions (MODEL_ASSISTED_REVIEW) are hidden from the human primary labeller until the primary label is committed; a review created before the primary's committed_at invalidates the adjudicated row.
Only ADJUDICATED_GOLD, adjudicated by a human, counts for headline teacher scoring.
